generators.label: Catalog import binds at most one DD path per name
generators.detail: write_standard_names links HAS_STANDARD_NAME only for names whose source_types contain 'dd' or 'signals', and only for the single path each name carries as source_id. A catalog entry lists several published paths per name (2 to 5 in this population); every path other than that one source_id is left unbound at import, and a name typed 'catalog' is skipped by both branches entirely.
generators.guard_note: require_producing_sources is called at write_standard_names' tail and refuses only a name with zero producers, so it permits the loss of every path but the one source_id bound. The 20 rows that hold no producer at all predate that call and are only repaired when a write touches them.

generators.label: One canonical source node per DD path, bound to one name
generators.detail: A DD source's identity is the path itself (id 'dd:<path>'), so the graph holds exactly one StandardNameSource per DD path. When another name is composed for the same path, PRODUCED_NAME is written for that name and the catalog name that also published the path keeps none: the binding is moved, not copied.
generators.guard_note: No guard pairs the losing name; the single-producer model is the guard's blind spot.

generators.label: Published path removed at a DD horizon
generators.detail: Three published paths are marked lifecycle_status='removed' on their IMASNode. The node survives (never deleted), but no live source is composed from a removed path, so the binding is gone by design.
generators.guard_note: check_sn_links_safe asserts edge counts never decrease; a removal that unbinds a catalog name is not measured by it.

generators.label: Published path renamed in the DD
generators.detail: Two published paths carry a RENAMED_TO edge to their successor path. The name keeps no binding on either side, because the successor path was assigned to a different name.

generators.label: Source extracted or stale and never bound
generators.detail: A StandardNameSource exists for the path in status 'extracted' or 'stale' with no PRODUCED_NAME to any live name. Composition has not run, or the source was marked stale and never requeued.

invariant.covers_drafts_note: The predicate is a copula condition on the name's own status; it is 'superseded' that is exempt, and a draft with zero producers is refused. Drafts are covered. But the condition is producers = 0, so a draft that kept one of several published paths passes.

repairs.goal: Import every published catalog path for a name, not only its source_id, and type catalog names so they qualify.
repairs.guard_test_fails_on_main: tests/standard_names/test_catalog_import_all_paths.py: an entry listing three DD paths yields three PRODUCED_NAME edges after write_standard_names; on main it yields one.

repairs.goal: Let one DD path's source bind every name whose catalog entry published that path, so a later compose copies rather than moves it.
repairs.guard_test_fails_on_main: tests/standard_names/test_source_multi_binding.py: composing 'dd:<path>' for a second name leaves the first name's PRODUCED_NAME intact; on main the second compose leaves one edge.

repairs.goal: Widen the invariant from zero-producer to the recorded published path set, so partial loss is refused rather than only total loss.
repairs.guard_test_fails_on_main: tests/standard_names/test_source_invariant_published_set.py: a draft keeping 1 of 3 recorded paths raises MissingStandardNameSource; on main it returns clean.

repairs.goal: Report sourceless drafts in the audit without letting them block a release.
repairs.guard_test_fails_on_main: tests/standard_names/test_export_audit_drafts.py: a draft with no producer appears in the audit's report and does not raise the release gate.

audit_change.should_report: Report every live name with no producer, whatever its stage, in a separate 'releasable=false' section keyed by stage; only accepted and approved names may contribute to the release refusal.
